verdict.rationale: Orrick's Technology Companies Group and Tech Studio materials confirm it advises startups from incubation onward, and community testimonials corroborate hands-on incorporation help (e.g., 'helped me tremendously with my incorporation (c-corp Delaware)'), plus historical free incorporation document sets used to form companies. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of the specific deliverables named in the story (charter, bylaws, initial board consents, founder stock purchase agreement) — the only interactive forms cited are a Germany Incorporation Questionnaire and a Convertible Note Term Sheet Creator, not a US incorporation packet. Missing for 10: explicit listing/description of charter, bylaws, board consent, and founder stock purchase documents as part of the engagement, and independent confirmation beyond a single old HN thread.
